name: cineweave-director
description: CineWeave creative Skill suite for controlled character identity and styling, scene interaction, professional directing, production recipes, evidence, capability matching, rights and ControlBench validation.

interface.shortDescription: Character, scene, director and production-control workflows.
interface.longDescription: CineWeave Creative Skills v1.1 coordinates four Codex Skills. Character owns reusable identity, detailed makeup/hair/costume states, behavior logic, emotion and performance. Scene owns reusable geography, time/weather/light states and grounded character-environment interactions. Director composes exact character, scene and interaction bindings into professional storyboards, prompts and render plans. Production owns deterministic AssetRecipes, hard/soft/advisory ControlChannels, scoped EvidenceBundles, provider-neutral CapabilityProfiles, explicit LicenseProfiles and ControlBench evaluation suites. The system never assumes commercial rights, hides capability mismatch, writes Canon, exposes private paths, calls paid Providers or claims media generation without evidence.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use CineWeave Character to define identity, styling and performance; CineWeave Scene to define geography, environmental state and interactions; CineWeave Director to design shots; and CineWeave Production to compile recipes, controls, evidence, capability and rights gates before a human-approved RenderPlan.
